name: product-capability-layer
_why: Kept with no dependencies so `npm audit` still resolves for any JS a product adds later. It previously existed only for tools/run_workflow.mjs and the agent SDK, both deleted 2026-08-07 -- see decisions/2026-08-07-one-workflow-engine.md. An audit over zero dependencies passes trivially; that is an honest report of this repo's JS surface, not a weakened gate.
